name: ResultDiff
description:
A change preview — config, registry or policy — as a unified diff: removed lines on the
danger tint, added lines on the success tint, the sign in the gutter so the change reads
without colour too. The target is a context chip; the counts are the data line.

props.name: result
props.type: ResultBase & { type: "diff"; target?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; language?: string; lines: import("../types.js").DiffLine[]; }
props.description: The diff result: `lines` in order (added, removed or context), an optional `target` entity shown as a chip, and the title used in the accessible name.
